value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 (walking) to 3 year olds with a parent - their site says Term 1 is Sept 14 to Nov 1 and Term 2 Nov 2 to Dec 20, and Term 1 registration opened July 22 at 8am online. I could not pin down the day or the price, and I'll keep watching and text you when I do.
